command: uid="$(id -u)" || exit; pids="$(pgrep -x -u "$uid" opencode)"; status=$?; [ "$status" -eq 0 ] || [ "$status" -eq 1 ] || exit "$status"; for pid in $pids; do kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || continue; args="$(ps -o args= -p "$pid")"; status=$?; if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || continue; exit "$status"; fi; set -f; set -- $args; [ "${1##*/}" = opencode ] || continue; shift; first=""; for word do case "$word" in -*) continue;; *) first="$word"; break;; esac; done; signal=0; if [ -z "$first" ] || [ "$first" = attach ]; then signal=1; else case "$first" in .|..|*/*) case "$first" in /*) [ -d "$first" ] && signal=1;; *) [ -d "/proc/$pid/cwd/$first" ] && signal=1;; esac;; esac; fi; [ "$signal" = 1 ] || continue; kill -USR2 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; done
